description: Repairs r-sql-1/b-ado: ND was never created (3292). Asks whether ADO (ADODB.Connection, Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0, adModeRead, Data Source through Properties) gives the same metadata and rows as DAO for the Decimal UNION texts and the stored x of ND: each text through Connection.Execute (Fields Name/Type/DefinedSize/Precision/NumericScale/Attributes, rows, Connection.Errors cleared before and read after); then DAO opens the same copy read-only and runs the same texts. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-sql1 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
